messages.content: Independent enterprise release-risk reviewer for exact SHA 515785504c3dbb4d68492cd34dd360cce992be21. P means PASS and F means FAIL. Return F only for a concrete unresolved material defect. Deployment and a live paid smoke are separately gated next steps, not prerequisites for this code release. Output schema JSON only.

Exact V9 release candidate 515785504c3dbb4d68492cd34dd360cce992be21. A server-side Higgsfield Seedance 2.5 text-to-video adapter is added under the existing provider-neutral contract. No Media Factory Higgsfield credential is configured and no paid provider request was made during validation. Production must report CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED until the encrypted credential is configured. Every paid request requires an authenticated owner/admin approval binding job/revision/provider/model/request SHA/prompt SHA/estimate/input hashes. A durable SUBMISSION_PENDING attempt is recorded before POST; ambiguous submission without request_id can never auto-resubmit. Persisted request_id is reused across restart. Crash-after-collection resumes from the exact SHA-bound artifact without a second request. failed/nsfw never auto-retry. Reference/mascot scenes fail closed; no silent text-only fallback. Provider status telemetry remains separate from Graph workflow percentage and Higgsfield percent is null because numeric render percentage is not authoritative. Provider output download is HTTPS-only, validates every DNS answer as public, pins the actual TLS download socket to a validated resolved address, revalidates each redirect, and enforces redirect/time/size/MIME bounds. Credentials stay in the existing encrypted IntegrationVault and never enter public job/provider projections. package.json, lockfile, auth, repository, Docker/Compose and deployment trust-root are unchanged. Exact validation: 198 tests discovered / 197 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 pre-existing SKIP; focused V9/core 48/48 PASS; typecheck/build/contracts 13/13/audit PASS; clean exact browser E2E PASS including provider telemetry and spend consent; clean exact non-test FIRMES completion PASS; detached exact verifier 38/38 plus typecheck/build/contracts/audit PASS. Runtime 1481 files, zero forbidden entries and zero external symlinks; manifest 5afae8d43b20173b378fb03416aaeb5cb5efc8ed58e32debbbf859db24a0b93a; production-source 7deda35e5b0fced97a207b137555b422d7b250bea1751034ebfdb57679f3880c. A pre-fix review cycle is preserved: an initial browser fixture routing defect was fixed test-only; then a source review identified DNS-check/download TOCTOU risk and fixed it by pinning the HTTPS request to the validated DNS address. No live paid smoke is claimed; that remains a separate gated operation requiring a real server credential plus explicit spend approval.
